title: Report revenue by month
prompt: Leave out cancelled orders. For each month in which orders were placed, return month (the month number of ordered_at, 1 to 12), orders (how many orders were placed) and revenue (the total of quantity * unit_price over their items). Sort by month.
hints: After joining orders to their items, a row is one item. What does that do to a count of orders?
Group by the month number. Count each order once, and add up every item.
EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.ordered_at) AS month, count(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders, sum(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS revenue

wrongAnswers.misconception: Counts item rows and reports them as orders.

feedback: Test one month with a plain query: count the orders placed in it that are not cancelled, using the orders table alone.
